goal: Speed up block propagation by predictively prefilling missing transactions into compact blocks
Avoid extra round-trips during block reconstruction while staying within the peer's TCP window
reviewability: This PR sits on top of #36787 and includes its diff
agreement: Strong support with substantive review and no remaining open objections
Concept approval praising simplicity and backwards compatibility (josibake, 0xB10C)
Verified with live node telemetry showing improved reconstruction rates (m4ycon, s00ly)
Detailed review caught concurrency and socket-call issues that were resolved (andrewtoth)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because nodes reconstruct ~90% of compact blocks without an extra round-trip, up from ~57%
Substantially reduces hop-by-hop relay latency and stale block risk across the network
